assignmentTitle: Design of a Helical Compression Spring for Motorcycle Suspension

criteria.title: Observe the Motorcycle Suspension
criteria.description: Understanding client brief, motorcycle rear twin-shock suspension application, and project scope.

criteria.title: Identify the Suspension Components
criteria.description: Accurate labeling of helical compression spring, hydraulic damper, upper/lower spring seats, swingarm/frame eyes, and preload adjuster collar on EA-12.

criteria.title: Understand the Load Path
criteria.description: Distinguishing mechanical roles of helical spring (energy storage/restoring force) and damper (energy dissipation).

criteria.title: Establish Design Requirements
criteria.description: Identifying working load (1250 N), deflection (45 mm), shear modulus G, and target spring index C = 6.0.

criteria.title: Determine Spring Geometry
criteria.description: Calculating mean coil diameter D = 48 mm, outer diameter Do = 56 mm, and inner diameter Di = 40 mm.

criteria.title: Design the Helical Compression Spring
criteria.description: Calculating Wahl factor K = 1.2525, max torsional shear stress tau = 373.76 N/mm², and active coils N = 13.

criteria.title: Verify Strength and Deflection
criteria.description: Verifying actual Factor of Safety (FoS = 1.20) and spring stiffness (k = 27.78 N/mm).

criteria.title: Evaluate the Motorcycle Application
criteria.description: Evaluating spring suitability under passenger payload and bump impact loading.

criteria.title: Engineering Recommendation
criteria.description: Recommending shot peening, material upgrades, or wire diameter adjustments for enhanced fatigue life.

criteria.title: Engineering Design Report
criteria.description: Synthesizing concise engineering design report covering spring dimensions, stress checks, FoS, and manufacturing specs.
